english.note: This is the all-purpose formal term, especially in written or technical contexts, for something descriptive rather than prescriptive.

examples.english: This paper uses a descriptive approach to analyse Cantonese grammar.
examples.traditional: 呢篇論文採用描述性方法分析粵語語法。
